verdict.rationale: Bidirectional clipboard sync with an off switch is a fair question to ask of a remote-desktop product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions clipboard sharing or a way to disable it; the docs cover pricing tiers, AI features, device management and the Web API, and the community posts discuss billing, security and scammers.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off
